accepted_advisories.reason: Content-encoding error DoS. Published 2026-10-23 and re-reviewed 2026-10-27. Pi pins undici 8.10.2 exactly in every release through 1.4.0, so no supported host clears it; already present in the 1.0.2 baseline. The adapter contract runs the host offline against fixtures. ADR-0041 strict-subset retention.
